title: Cache the invoke
prompt: Implement `static Func<object?, object?> BuildGetter(Type type, string propertyName)` that returns a DELEGATE reading the given instance property via reflection — and the delegate must be CACHED: two calls with the same (type, name) return the SAME delegate instance, and invoking the cached delegate performs the PropertyInfo work already captured, not a fresh resolve. Also implement `static object? Read(object target, string prop) => BuildGetter(target.GetType(), prop)(target);`.

tests.name: cached-and-works
tests.hint: Cache delegates in a static ConcurrentDictionary<(Type, string), Func<object?, object?>>; capture the PropertyInfo inside the factory.

tests.name: allocation-profile
tests.hint: Do the GetProperty work ONCE inside the cached factory; the returned delegate must not resolve per invoke.
